note: Pictures the reader shows between chapters and after each ending. A chapter is a station: its start node and every node named <prefix>_*. Leaving a chapter shows its picture and a 'Next chapter' button. Made with illustration-prompts.json. `cover` replaces the graph's cover in the reader (`titled`: the title is in the picture, so it is not printed again); `back_cover` closes the book after an ending.

cover.alt: Odin's Lost Raven: Elsie on a root of the World Tree, the raven on her shoulder, looking through the sunstone; Jorvik and a longship below, the wolf chasing the sun in the sky.

back_cover.alt: A black raven on an old post, oak leaves around it and the World Tree faint behind.

chapters.alt: Elsie, a raven on her shoulder, in a muddy lane of wattle houses in Viking Jorvik, long ships beyond.
Elsie and Ketil on the old wall at night, looking at countless enemy fires on the western hills.
The Sea-Hart under her striped sail on the wide river, Elsie and Ketil hauling a rope, the town's smoke far behind.
Fog lifting from the sea to show the cliffs and waterfalls of a Norwegian fjord, Ketil in the bow.
Elsie's small runestone on the fjord shore at dusk, a raven on it, the ship grave on the hill and a giant tree faint in the sky.
Elsie on a root of the World Tree with two ravens, a giant wolf chasing the sun far off in the sky.
The lone gate Valgrind on a hillside, Elsie beside it, and the vast shield-roofed hall of Valhalla beyond.
Valhalla's west door splitting as the wolf Sköll pushes his muzzle through, Elsie small in the foreground.

e_hero.alt: Elsie and Grandad at the museum case holding the sunstone, a raven on the roof outside the window.

e_clean.alt: Elsie and Grandad detecting in a frosty field, a raven circling high above.

e_scarred.alt: Elsie alone at the museum case with the sunstone, puzzled, a black feather at her feet.

e_wounded.alt: Elsie touching the crooked runes of an old stone in the museum, Grandad watching behind her.

e_costly.alt: Elsie waking in the frozen field with Grandad bending over her, a raven far off that she does not see.

e_pyrrhic.alt: York at noon under a dim brown sun, people staring up, Elsie walking home alone, a wolf shape faint in the clouds.
